## Context / Problem

PyPI serves 0.16.0. Main since v0.16.0 (138 commits, tip `c5d79d09b4fa` on 2026-11-23) carries new user- and agent-visible surface: per-environment op-cert trust (ADR 0125: new `verify.trusted_opcert_keys` config key, new `untrusted` verdict and `signing_key` result field, removal of `rebar trusted-env` and `.rebar/trusted_environments.yaml`), `rebar --version`, async MCP starters for `review_code` and closes, and a local release build check. It also carries many store, review-bot, MCP, LLM-transport and Windows fixes. The operator asked for a minor release cut per `docs/releasing.md` with the `release.yml` GitHub Action.

Version: **0.17.0**. The op-cert trust change removes a command and a repository file and adds config and contract fields, so a minor bump is the matching SemVer step under `docs/api-stability.md` (0.x minors may carry new and breaking surface). The `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` section is empty, so the entries are curated from `git log v0.16.0..HEAD`. `docs/release-notes.md` already has an `Unreleased` section for ADR 0125, which this release renames to 0.17.0.

## Approach

Follow `docs/releasing.md` §"Release procedure":
1. In a fresh worktree at origin/main: bump `pyproject.toml` `version`, and `server.json` top-level `version` and every `packages[].version`, to 0.17.0; `uv lock`; write `## [0.17.0] - <release date>` in `CHANGELOG.md` with hand-curated Added/Changed/Removed/Fixed entries reconciled against `git log v0.16.0..HEAD`, a fresh empty `## [Unreleased]` above it, and the `[0.17.0]` compare-link footer; retitle the `docs/release-notes.md` `Unreleased` ADR 0125 section to `0.17.0`; `make install` then `python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --update` (only `__version__` is expected to change in `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json`; any other diff is investigated before commit).
2. `make verify` and `make release-build-check`; one commit with a `rebar-ticket:` trailer and `-s`; push to Gerrit with the session hashtag; Submit with `scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py <n> --revision <sha>` at LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 and 0 unresolved comments.
3. `gh workflow run release.yml --ref main -f version=0.17.0`.
4. Approve the pending `pypi` deployment via `POST repos/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/$RUN/pending_deployments` with a JSON `--input` body (`environment_ids` integer array).
5. Confirm every channel; trigger `gh workflow run autobump.yml --repo navapbc/homebrew-rebar` if the tap has not bumped. Smoke test: `pipx install "nava-rebar[mcp]==0.17.0" --force`, `rebar --version` reports 0.17.0, and `scripts/probe_rebar.py` against the installed binary passes.

A failed publish is not retried over a published version: PyPI versions are immutable, so a defect found after publish is yanked and fixed in 0.17.1 per `docs/releasing.md`.

## Scope

`pyproject.toml`, `server.json`, `uv.lock`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json`. No `src/rebar` change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Version bump commit landed on main through Gerrit (change number and merge SHA recorded in a comment); `make verify` and `make release-build-check` passed locally before push; `release_guards.py version-lockstep` passes in the run's `authorize` job.
- [x] [non-codebase] `release.yml` run for 0.17.0 completes successfully (run id recorded).
  provenance: environment=GitHub Actions navapbc/rebar; principal=release identity (gh CLI, JoeOakhartNava token); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — gh run view of the real workflow run
- [x] [non-codebase] PyPI: `curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/nava-rebar/json` reports `info.version` 0.17.0.
  provenance: environment=PyPI production (pypi.org); principal=anonymous public read; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — curl of the public JSON API that installers use
- [x] [non-codebase] GitHub Release: `gh release view v0.17.0 --repo navapbc/rebar` exists, marked Latest, with wheel and sdist attached.
  provenance: environment=GitHub navapbc/rebar releases; principal=gh API read; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — gh api repos/navapbc/rebar/releases/latest
- [x] [non-codebase] MCP Registry: `curl -s "https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=io.github.navapbc/rebar"` lists version 0.17.0.
  provenance: environment=registry.modelcontextprotocol.io production; principal=anonymous public read; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — curl of the public v0 servers endpoint
- [x] [non-codebase] Homebrew: `Formula/rebar.rb` in `navapbc/homebrew-rebar` points at the 0.17.0 sdist (`gh api repos/navapbc/homebrew-rebar/contents/Formula/rebar.rb`).
  provenance: environment=GitHub navapbc/homebrew-rebar main; principal=gh API read; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — gh api contents/Formula/rebar.rb plus the autobump run
- [x] [non-codebase] Smoke: a clean `pipx install "nava-rebar[mcp]==0.17.0"` reports `rebar --version` 0.17.0 and `scripts/probe_rebar.py` passes against it.
  provenance: environment=operator Mac, fresh pipx venv from PyPI; principal=operator shell; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — install from the public index and run the probe
